title: Player metric landscape: where the honest line is drawn
headline_insight: From 77,744 box-score rows the system can honestly build box-only value and unadjusted on/off, but RAPM, EPM, DARKO, BPM and RAPTOR are all marked do-not-fake because the inputs do not exist.
what_it_means: The landscape maps which player metrics the raw data actually supports. Full box scores (0% missing across 807 players and 3,611 games) support a transparent box-only value index, per-36 rates, and unadjusted on/off. But branded impact metrics require a league-wide RAPM target or continuous tracking the repo does not have, so they are explicitly not reproduced.
how_to_read: Each metric family carries a verdict of supported, partial, or not_supported alongside the exact input columns it would need.
why_it_matters: It draws a hard line between what is honestly computable from box data and what would amount to faking a proprietary metric under a borrowed name.
caveat: Support means raw input-column coverage only, never a claim that a branded metric is reproduced; the gravity proxy, for example, rests on a 241-game CV subset, not league-wide coverage.
